latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of browser-capture:

- Enables capturing webpage screenshots and images using OpenClaw Browser.
- Smart filtering to return only real content images (not icons, logos, buttons, or avatars).
- Prioritizes full-size images on detail pages, with size-based filtering (ignores small icons).
- Provides step-by-step workflow and command usage for intelligent image extraction and processing.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and clear tool documentation for all browser-related commands.
